title: Trump hints at public ‘contribution’ from US AI firms, sparking speculation
description: US President Donald Trump suggested on Monday that leading American artificial intelligence companies would make a public “contribution” to the country, offering few details but fuelling speculation about a greater government role in the booming industry. title: Gov. Pritzker signs first-in-nation Illinois law requiring third-party safety audits for AI giants
description: CHICAGO — Illinois will be the first state to require independent audits of large artificial intelligence developers’ safety practices under a new law Gov. JB Pritzker signed Monday.
